scope: Native accepted-child selected-type ownership, stable borrowing identity, plain state copying and explicitly unknown boundary storage. Incremental work in the unfinished native renderer objective.

cases: Direct, computed and structural-alias entry reads follow the child selector, with a conflicting outer selector and concurrent Render/Write requests.
Two independently selected scalar fields retain their own types in a mixed component list across concurrent requests.
Untyped state copies lose borrowing identity and expose the raw prop snapshot.
Borrowed slots keep the original caller scope.
Empty entry size/truthiness includes only props, excluding private state slots.
Unknown scoped props drop originating selected checks.
A typed state copy with a nested unknown field retains object storage and raw dimensional strings.
Unknown scalar and nested structured scoped inputs do not infer dimensions from strings.
redEvidence: Selected structured defaults rendered :3 in the child but bad:3 through its receiver and aliases.
Untyped entry state copy produced true: instead of false:3.
Empty entry/private state produced wrong:wrong:false instead of empty:empty:false.
Owner-aware entries initially caused a declared unknown scoped prop to hide the raw numeric value.
The nested unknown-field state copy produced : instead of 10px: before the proved projection correction.
